name: LegacyGivingPipeline
tagline: Gifts in wills, from first conversation to final estate distribution.
description: A complete planned-giving app for nonprofits in one Power Apps component: drag-and-drop legacy pipeline with stage rules, expectancy register with probability, weighted and present value, a 10-year realisation forecast, estate administration with interim and final distributions, legacy society membership and stewardship touches with overdue alerts. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Stage rules from Prospect to Realised
Estate administration: probate, interim and final distributions
Irrevocable vehicles (gift annuity, remainder trust, retained life estate)
Legacy society: enrol, recognition, in memoriam
Stewardship log with next actions and overdue alerts
Bulk owner / next action / enrol / export
